page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn7ix.32xlarge is a GPU-accelerated bare-metal instance designed for high-performance computing workloads. It features 128 dedicated physical cores powered by Intel Xeon 8369B processors running at a base frequency of 2.9 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance is configured with 512.0 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance is equipped with eight NVIDIA A10 GPUs, delivering a combined total of 192 GB of VRAM. It does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through network-attached options. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline network bandwidth of 160 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers.

Given the high density of dedicated CPU cores and multiple enterprise-grade GPUs, this instance represents a significant resource allocation suited for parallel processing tasks. It is qualitatively positioned as a high-tier resource for workloads that justify the cost of dedicated hardware and multi-GPU acceleration. Appropriate workloads include deep learning training, large-scale AI inference, high-performance computing, and complex graphics rendering.
